plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused full-body S&C session each week so it fits around higher sparring and skill work. Week 1 is used to establish simple bodyweight performance baselines for your main movements, then Weeks 2-4 build strength, power, and trunk control with low-equipment work and controlled volume.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic full-body strength, explosive intent, and trunk stiffness with simple bodyweight work that does not interfere with sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress harder bodyweight variations and keep explosive quality high while trimming any work that adds fatigue without payoff.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength with a small dose and shift more emphasis to sharper, faster, more reactive output.
